svg.title: Khooneh 1405 · Yard elevation · A-302
svg.text: Seen from the yard (west on the left).
Every outside face is brick: blender/lib/facade_plan.py's rule (a face onto the outside or an outdoor room is facade).
Walls, columns and voids on the face from interiors-ai.json and structure-1405.json; below ground dashed.
Windows and doors from openings-ai.json: id, sill/head in m above their floor; dashed lines meet on the hinge side.
Roof parapet +17.76, coping +17.90 (details-1405.json); stair house from the SH level.
Balcony rails drawn at the roof guard height (1.10 m above the pavers): no balcony rail height is in the data.
From the plan data through the pipeline (pages/permit_drawings.py). The AI's proposal: no engineer or architect has checked it.
Levels in m from ±0.00, the ground floor
Drawn by: AI, from the pipeline
